title: Rudyom
summary_html: Rudyom is a mage living in Cove in Ultima VI and Ultima VII. He is noted for his experiments regarding blackrock which eventually came to serendipitously produce an artifact of crucial importance to the Avatar’s quest to prevent the Guardian’s invasion of Britannia.
